notes.title: Nayati River is now on Steam!
notes.content:
Nayati River has been created by only one person during an almost three-years exciting solo project, and the game is out now! 

Nayati River will be frequently updated, in order to offer the best experience of survival and adventure and meet the expectations of the community.
